paper_title: First Scan Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter with a Tunable Superconducting Radio-Frequency Cavity
notes: Dark photon exclusion limit from Figure 3 of the paper. The SRF cavity scanned frequencies from 1.299-1.301 GHz centered at 1.3 GHz, corresponding to dark photon masses of 5.373-5.381 × 10^-6 eV. The kinetic mixing coefficient ε (also written χ) is constrained to be less than 2.2 × 10^-15 across this narrow mass range, as stated in the paper's abstract. The limit is presented as flat across the scanned region. Confidence level is 90% from Eq. (S13) of the supplementary material. Data extracted from high-resolution Figure 3 showing the SRF scanning results (red region) compared to other existing constraints.
